scope: The nineteen outstanding Scryfall commander-type boxed/preconstructed release-family codes from 2023 through October 2026. Official Wizards decklist articles establish marketed Commander products, not Scryfall set-code issuance, first-printing dates, or complete physical print inventories.
source_policy: Preserve the frozen October 29 Scryfall code, earliest card date and explicit parent unmodified. Wizards product dates need not equal a Scryfall set-code earliest printing date. In particular FDC has 2024-11-15 Scryfall metadata but Wizards announces the five Foundations Commander decks for October 2, 2026. Do not present those as 2024 boxed decks or infer card legality.
